text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho, the Japan Cup,
and the
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen has managed to win all
three.
What comes after is a shower of
gifts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew! That makes the last of them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for taking up so much space in
your
office.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I'm very thankful for everyone's

generosity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It was only with your help that I found
success in
the Twin Tenno Sho, a first for
the Mejiro family,
as well as the Senior
Autumn Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
For all of this, I am extremely grateful.
Thank you
very—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock
Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I'm sorry. Were you in the middle
of
something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Satono. No, you aren't interrupting
anything.
What can we do for you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I came to congratulate the two of you.

Congratulations on your Senior Autumn
Triple
Crown!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's very thoughtful of you.
Thank you for
going out of your way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But we've already received your
celebratory gift,
Satono.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It was the largest package to come—a
golden
claw machine filled with plushies
of myself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, that alone isn't enough! That's why I
came to
speak with you directly.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're truly amazing, McQueen. I was
reminded
of this when I saw you race the
other day.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You've become an even more dazzling
role model
for the rest of us. I've never
been happier.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I will put all my efforts into pursuing the
kind of
radiance you have.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Um, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. That just didn't sound like
much of
a congratulatory thing to say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You seemed to be declaring your
intentions to
surpass me one day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's all right though, don't worry. I
accept
your competitive spirit as the
greatest
congratulations I could receive.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to competing with you.
The
challenge you bring will push me to
even greater
heights.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay. I know I'll get there someday!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen has accomplished a lot,
but she
won't stop there. Her heart races
in anticipation
of gaining a new rival.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
By the way, are you enjoying the claw
game?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Since you knew what was inside
the box, I
assumed you'd played it
already.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-I certainly intend to capture all of the
plushies
one of these days!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen has become Senior
Autumn
Triple Crown champion. What
she will accomplish
next is anyone's
guess!
